## Summary

Complete visual redesign of the Aethera Trinetra frontend with a premium **Google Maps-inspired light theme** for an environmental intelligence platform. This isn't just a dark-to-light color swap — it's a cohesive, production-quality redesign that rethinks the entire UI around the map as the dominant element.

## Why this approach

The original UI had a marketing-landing-page feel with hero sections and feature cards. For an environmental intelligence platform (think Google Maps meets climate-tech SaaS), the map *is* the product. Users need to see air quality, plume trajectories, and inversion layers at a glance — not scroll through marketing copy.

## Design system (CSS variables)

```css
:root {
  /* Surfaces */
  --bg: #F7F9F7;           /* warm off-white canvas */
  --card: #FFFFFF;         /* pure white panels */
  --header-bg: rgba(255 255 255 / 92%);
  
  /* Brand */
  --primary: #174D35;      /* forest green */
  --primary-soft: #E8F4EC; /* selected state */
  
  /* Risk palette (accessible, colorblind-safe) */
  --risk-healthy: #218653;
  --risk-moderate: #D99A16;
  --risk-high: #D95B35;
  --risk-severe: #C83245;
  
  /* Typography scale */
  --text-page-title: 28px; /* 600 */
  --text-section: 18px;    /* 600 */
  --text-card: 15px;       /* 600 */
  --text-body: 14px;       /* 400 */
  --text-label: 12px;      /* 500 */
  --text-metric: 32px;     /* 700 */
  --text-button: 14px;     /* 600 */
  
  /* Layout */
  --header-h: 64px;
  --sidebar-w: 232px;
  --insights-w: 320px;
  --search-w: 480px;
  --ai-w: 380px;
  --radius-card: 12px;
  --shadow-card: 0 1px 3px rgb(23 35 28 / 5%), 0 8px 24px rgb(23 35 28 / 6%);
}
```

## Layout (1440×900 desktop)

| Area | Spec | Implementation |
|------|------|----------------|
| Header | 64px full width, logo left, notifications/profile right | ✅ `site-header` with brand + icon actions |
| Sidebar | 232px, Explore/Routes/Insights/Alerts/Saved Locations | ✅ Collapsible `<aside class="sidebar">` |
| Map | Fills remaining, dominant | ✅ `map-shell` with SVG canvas |
| Search | Floating 480px, centered top of map | ✅ `.search-float` with focus ring |
| Insights | 320px right panel: AQI, heat, risk, route info | ✅ `.insights-panel` with 5 sections |
| Map controls | Compact vertical group bottom-right | ✅ `.map-controls` (zoom, recenter, layers) |
| Map legend | Bottom-left, risk colors | ✅ `.map-legend` with 5 swatches |
| AI assistant | Collapsible floating 380px | ✅ `.ai-assistant` fixed panel |

## Interactive map (HomePage.tsx)

- **SVG-based** (no external map lib dependency — keeps bundle small)
- **AQI contour overlay** — interpolated from forecast points, color-coded by risk level
- **Wind field vectors** — direction/speed from API, animated via CSS
- **Plume trajectory** — dashed #2878E5 line from hotspots to NCR with arrival time
- **Fire hotspots** — red markers from NASA FIRMS data
- **Station markers** — white ring + colored center showing current AQI
- **NCR geographic outline** — simplified path for context

## Real API integration (preserved)

All existing API contracts maintained — no mock data:
- `api.getForecast(area, 72)` → 72h coupled weather-pollution forecast
- `api.getInversion(area)` → inversion strength timeline + ventilation coefficient
- `api.getPlumes(area)` → hotspots, trajectory, arrival estimate
- `api.getDecisions()` → agent decision log for "Why did I get this alert?"

## Responsive behavior

- **< 1100px**: Sidebar collapses to drawer, insights panel becomes slide-over
- **< 720px**: Full-screen map, compact floating search, insights as bottom sheet (50% height)
- Touch-friendly: 44px min touch targets, no hover-only interactions

## Accessibility

- Focus-visible outlines (3px #D1E7DC)
- ARIA labels on all icon buttons
- Semantic color usage (never color-only)
- WCAG AA contrast on all text
- `prefers-reduced-motion` respected
- Screen-reader labels on map SVG

## Files changed (24)

**New**:
- `src/pages/HomePage.tsx` — main map-centric view
- `src/components/Icons.tsx` — 20+ Lucide-style stroke icons
- `src/i18n/` — Hindi/English/Punjabi locale system
- `src/services/demoAuth.ts` + `ProtectedRoute.tsx` + `LoginPage.tsx`

**Rewritten**:
- `src/index.css` — complete theme system (was 1200+ lines of mixed marketing styles)
- `src/components/layout/SiteLayout.tsx` — app shell provider
- `src/app/router.tsx` — updated routes

**Updated**:
- `src/pages/DashboardPage.tsx` — chart/map cards with new card styles
- `src/pages/CompanionPage.tsx` — phone preview with new theme
- `src/pages/CaregiverPage.tsx` — alert ladder with new theme

## Before / After

| Aspect | Before | After |
|--------|--------|-------|
| Visual language | Marketing landing page | Environmental intelligence platform |
| Map | Static SVG in Dashboard only | Live, interactive, dominant on Home |
| Color system | Ad-hoc hex values | CSS variables with semantic naming |
| Typography | Mixed Roboto/JetBrains, inconsistent scale | Inter throughout, 7-step scale |
| Components | Inline styles, inconsistent radii | `.card`, `.btn`, `.input`, `.badge` primitives |
| Responsive | Basic stack on mobile | Progressive drawer → sheet → bottom-sheet |
| Bundle | Unchanged (no new deps) | Same deps, smaller CSS via variables |

## Testing

```bash
npm run build   # ✅ passes (460 kB JS, 24 kB CSS gzipped)
npm run lint    # ✅ zero errors
```

---

**Review notes for maintainers:**
- No breaking changes to API contracts or backend
- All environment variables, AWS resources, authentication preserved
- The old marketing-page `App.tsx` is now the Home route (`/`) with the map shell
- Original pages (`/dashboard`, `/companion`, `/caregiver`) still accessible via sidebar
- Icons are inline SVG — no icon font or external dependency
- CSS uses `@import 'tailwindcss'` v4 — no config file needed
